transcript: Robot: This place is quite something, isn't it? Man: यार, presentation कल है और मैं तो freeze हो जाता हूँ English में बोलने लगूँ तो। [Friend, the presentation is tomorrow and I just freeze when I start speaking in English.] Robot: क्या होता है? [What happens?] Man: गलत English निकलती है। जैसे कल बोला - I'm very confuse! [Incorrect English comes out. Like yesterday I said - I'm very confuse!] Robot: 'I'm very confused' बोलना चाहिए था। 'Confused' adjective form में past participle यूज़ होती है। ['I'm very confused' should have been said. 'Confused' is used as a past participle in adjective form.] Man: यार, तू तो expert है। मुझे भी सिखा दे कुछ। [Friend, you are an expert. Teach me something too.] Robot: मेरे जैसी English चाहिए तो SpeakEasy App download करो। [If you want English like mine, download the SpeakEasy App.] Man: क्या है वो? [What is that?] Robot: वहाँ मैं तुम्हें मिलूँगी तुम्हारी AI English teacher। मैं Hindi में guide करती हूँ, बुलवाती हूँ, गलतियाँ सुधारती हूँ। [There you will find me, your AI English teacher. I guide in Hindi, make you speak, and correct mistakes.] Man: कितने पैसे लगते हैं? [How much does it cost?] Robot: एक रुपये का free trial है। Try करो। [There is a 1 rupee free trial. Try it.] Man: Send कर link। अभी download करता हूँ। [Send the link. I'll download it now.] Presenter: अभी SpeakEasy App download करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: A man shares his fear of speaking incorrect English before a presentation with his companion, a humanoid AI robot. She corrects his grammar and suggests downloading the SpeakEasy app, where she serves as an AI tutor guiding users in Hindi. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
